title: Beauty and the Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beauty and the Beach, nestled in the desirable Grande Pointe community of Inlet Beach, is a masterpiece of coastal living. This four-level retreat boasts four spacious bedrooms, four full bathrooms, and two half baths, making it the perfect sanctuary for family getaways or group vacations. The third-floor game room, complete with a pool table, fridge, and wet bar, is designed for endless entertainment, while the fourth-floor deck offers breathtaking gulf views that will leave you captivated. With its elegant design and thoughtful amenities, this home promises a vacation experience you'll want to relive year after year. Set within the serene Grande Pointe community, this property provides access to a saltwater pool and a dock on picturesque Lake Powell, ideal for paddleboarding, kayaking, or fishing. Beyond the neighborhood, the iconic 30A area invites you to explore its charming towns, pristine white-sand beaches, and vibrant local culture. From boutique shopping and gourmet dining at nearby 30Avenue to the relaxed vibes of the Emerald Coast, every moment at Beauty and the Beach is an invitation to indulge in the best of coastal living.
